claim: BBS9 contacts specific BBSome subunits; ARL6 site is elsewhere
finding: 6VBU/6VBV: BBS9 buries 2734/2460/2193/1561/516/338/27 sq A against BBS5/BBS8/BBS1/BBS2/BBS7/BBS4/BBS18 and 0 against ARL6; ARL6 site is on BBS1+BBS7

claim: a central acidic cleft binds cargo and a basic patch binds membrane
finding: claims reproduced qualitatively, but my surface-potential mapping places both features on other subunits: BBS9 is 4.9% of the membrane-proximal surface (OR 0.169) and contributes 0 residues to the two largest acidic regions
confidence: high for subunit attribution; membrane normal is inferred

claim: the BBS9 beta-propeller is a protein-interaction module
finding: 4YD8 isolated propeller superposes on the in-complex conformation at TM 0.920-0.929, RMSD 0.88-0.96 A; G141R misfolds the propeller
BBS9 associates with the BBS2-BBS7 dimer via the BBS2 alpha-helical domain; BBS2 R632P at that interface disrupts binding

claim: BBS-9 binds BBS-1 in C. elegans
finding: IntAct records BBS-9:BBS-1 and BBS-9:DYF-2 physical association by BiFC (MI 0.37); bbs-1 and dyf-2 mutants lose IFT turnaround
context: C. elegans sensory cilia, in vivo
confidence: moderate; BiFC reports proximity, not a direct interface

finding: BBS1 and BBS9 are interface hubs within the complex, but GPCR contact hotspots are on BBS1, BBS4 and BBS5

claim: the human BBSome structure can substitute for the full complex
finding: 6XT9 is a BBS1/4/8/9/18 core and lacks BBS2, BBS5 and BBS7, so a human-only analysis under-reports three of BBS9's five partners; no Chlamydomonas BBSome exists in the PDB

claim: the worm BBSome has the same composition as the mammalian one
finding: the C. elegans BBSome is heptameric (bbs-1,-2,-4,-5,-7/osm-12,-8,-9); no BBIP1/BBS18 ortholog exists

claim: bovine interfaces transfer to C. elegans BBS-9
finding: 579 residue equivalences; 139 worm interface residues assigned to BBS-8 (49), BBS-5 (38), BBS-2 (30), BBS-1 (17), BBS-7 (13); BBS-4 contacts do not transfer (CtH TM 0.050)
confidence: graded: high for propeller/hairpin, low for GAE and CtH

claim: the predicted interfaces are under selection
finding: interface conservation 0.549 vs 0.388 for exposed non-interface residues; Mann-Whitney p=2.54e-12, CLES 0.694
